facts.source:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Lint
        run: |
          ruff check .
          ruff format --check .
      - name: Test
        run: pytest -q
        continue-on-error: true
      - run: npm run lint
        if: false
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ false }}
    steps:
      - run: python -m mypy src
      - run: >
          echo folded &&
          tsc --noEmit

stages:
  - test
  - build
test:
  stage: test
  script:
    - pytest -q
    - ruff check .
  allow_failure: true
build:
  stage: build
  script: npm run build
  allow_failure: "True"
variables:
  A: "1"

steps:
  - run: pytest
  - run: ruff check .

stages: [t]
t1:
  script: pytest
t2:
  script:
    - ruff check .
    - mypy .
variables:
  S: x

steps:
  - script: |
      pytest
      # comment
      ruff check .

steps:
  - steps:
      - run: pytest
        continue-on-error: true

jobs:
  a:
    continue-on-error: true
    allow_failure: true
    if: false
    steps: []

jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - run: pytest
  b:
    steps:
      - run: mypy .

jobs:
  a:
    steps: []
    env:
      x: 1
      x: 2

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 1'
env:
  NODE_VERSION: 20
jobs:
  build:
    name: Build (${{ matrix.os }}, py${{ matrix.python }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        python: ['3.11', '3.12']
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python: '3.13'
            experimental: true
        exclude: [{os: windows-latest, python: '3.11'}]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '${{ matrix.python }}', cache: pip}
      - name: Install
        run: |
          python -m pip install -U pip
          pip install -e .[dev]
      - name: Lint
        run: ruff check . && ruff format --check .
      - name: Test
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
        run: >-
          pytest -q
          --maxfail=1
      - name: Upload
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: logs-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: |
            logs/
            !logs/tmp

default:
  image: python:3.12
stages: [lint, test]
.cache: &cache
  paths: [.cache/pip]
lint:
  stage: lint
  script:
    - pip install ruff
    - ruff check .
    - |
      if [ -n "$CI" ]; then
        ruff format --check .
      fi
test:
  stage: test
  script:
    - pytest -q --cov
  coverage: '/TOTAL.*\s+(\d+%)$/'
  allow_failure: false

steps:
  - name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
    args: ['build', '-t', 'gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/app', '.']
  - name: python:3.12
    entrypoint: bash
    args:
      - -c
      - |
        pip install pytest
        pytest -q
images: ['gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/app']
timeout: 600s

trigger:
  - main
pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest
steps:
  - script: |
      npm ci
      npm test
    displayName: 'Test'
  - task: PublishTestResults@2
    inputs: {testResultsFiles: '**/junit.xml'}

shell: for f in *.py; do ruff check $f; done

strategy:
  matrix:
    os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    include:
      - os: ubuntu-latest
        py: '3.12'

t: True
f: FALSE
y: Yes

name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 1'
env:
  NODE_VERSION: 20
jobs:
  build:
    name: Build (${{ matrix.os }}, py${{ matrix.python }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        python: ['3.11', '3.12']
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python: '3.13'
            experimental: true
        exclude: [{os: windows-latest, python: '3.11'}]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '${{ matrix.python }}', cache: pip}
      - name: Install
        run: |
          python -m pip install -U pip
          pip install -e .[dev]
      - name: Lint
        run: ruff check . && ruff format --check .
      - name: Test
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
        run: >-
          pytest -q
          --maxfail=1
      - name: Upload
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: logs-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: |
            logs/
            !logs/tmp

default:
  image: python:3.12
stages: [lint, test]
.cache: &cache
  paths: [.cache/pip]
lint:
  stage: lint
  script:
    - pip install ruff
    - ruff check .
    - |
      if [ -n "$CI" ]; then
        ruff format --check .
